title: Repository sport mismatch and legacy NBA content
finding: The inherited root dashboard and most historical datasets are NBA research, not NFL evidence. They are preserved as archives and are not reused as NFL validation.

title: No verified sportsbook price archive
finding: Official NFL pages do not provide the executable sportsbook odds, de-vigged probabilities, settlement terms, CLV or net ROI required by G08. All such fields remain blank; no betting edge is claimed.

title: Prospective replication not run
finding: G10 requires at least 100 future selections locked before kickoff under the frozen protocol. This session produced a historical snapshot and current research lines only.

title: Small, incomplete player logs
finding: The four-player sample has 28 rows and 9 missing numeric cells. Blank cells are not zero-filled. Every player market fails the 100-observation gate and remains descriptive only.

title: Cross-player same-game correlation unverified
finding: There are no paired same-game observations for Smith-Njigba and Burden in this snapshot. Their cross-player correlation and joint price are blank/blocked rather than inferred.

title: Model conventions are not official NFL rules
finding: Independent Poisson team scores, draw-half win-share moneylines and half-integer fair lines are project modeling conventions. They are not official NFL distributions or verified sportsbook settlement rules.

title: Historical venue not inferred
finding: Weekly schedule listing order is not treated as home/away. Historical models omit home-field advantage. Only the upcoming Bears–Seahawks venue is officially confirmed.

title: Verified snapshot, not a live feed
finding: Official values were read from tool-retrieved NFL pages/excerpts and reconciled to official standings. Bash/CI cannot access NFL hosts from this sandbox; raw HTML is not archived and no automatic live refresh is claimed.

title: Gate thresholds are project policy
finding: Sample-size, calibration, ROI and prospective-replication thresholds are pre-registered project choices, not NFL-published facts. They are intentionally conservative and were not tuned to results.

title: Rewards are virtual and currently zero
finding: The competition awards non-monetary badges only. No strategy passed every gate, so no winner, points, cash prize or profit promise is produced.

title: Kickoff timezone label ambiguous
finding: The official schedule/Game Center displays 8:15 PM with a LOCAL label for a Seattle game. The snapshot uses the official date as the research cutoff and does not infer an exact UTC kickoff.

title: Other NFL module uses third-party historical/market data
finding: NFL Quant Lab is preserved as a separate contribution. Its historical/market inputs are not official NFL publications and are not used by this official-only lab. Its rows are inventoried but not certified as official-source verified here.

title: Active parallel pull request not taken over
finding: PR #24 owns nfl-research/** and remained open during this session. Its files were not edited or merged by this session. Final integration publishes only checked main-branch work plus this session's scope.

title: Legacy NBA claims not re-certified as NFL evidence
finding: The repository audit inventories legacy files and source links. NBA claims are outside the requested NFL scope and are not presented as NFL verification.

title: Initial 2026 game-count expectation corrected
finding: Before modeling, an arithmetic expectation of 121 completed 2026 games was corrected to 120 after reading the official weekly rows and standings. The final snapshot is 272 + 120 = 392 games; all standings cells reconcile.

title: Metric-specific calibration corrected before publication
finding: The calibration gate was corrected to evaluate win-share, own-spread cover and own-total over separately. No model parameter or gate threshold was changed after viewing results.

title: No primary trial survives Holm correction
finding: Several bootstrap intervals exclude zero, but none of the six primary permutation tests survives Holm correction at 0.05. This is evidence of uncertainty, not a validated betting edge.

title: Point-in-time availability inputs missing
finding: Historical injury/lineup/active-roster snapshots and market void rules are not available in this snapshot. G09 blocks release; a current profile marked active is not a pregame availability guarantee.

title: Data rights and production licensing not cleared
finding: This is a small research transcription with source links, not legal clearance for bulk production scraping or commercial redistribution. NFL terms and licensing require separate review before production use.

title: Fixed Arena branch constraint
finding: The environment pins work to arena/22c1775e-own4 and prohibits creating other branches. Scope isolation and append-only coordination replace the requested session-<id>/<task> branch naming.

title: Raw archived HTML is not navigable site content
finding: Legacy data/raw HTML captures contain origin-relative asset links from their source sites. They are preserved as evidence, excluded from published-dashboard navigation checks, and are not linked as dashboard pages.
